name: Charlie Kirk
role: Founder of Turning Point USA and host of The Charlie Kirk Show (1993-2025)
summary: An American conservative activist and MAGA-aligned commentator who built Turning Point USA into a large campus and church organizing network. He backed free markets, tariffs and sharply lower immigration, opposed abortion, gun control, same-sex marriage and transgender recognition, doubted mainstream climate science, and moved from a secular outlook to openly advocating a Christian public order. On foreign policy he opposed aid to Ukraine and a US war with Iran while calling himself strongly pro-Israel.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Turning Point USA, which he founded, states its mission as promoting free markets, fiscal responsibility and limited government.

legalize-drugs.rationale: On Bill Maher's podcast he said adults can get as drunk as they like in private but drew limits on public drug use, rejected injection sites and was critical of marijuana normalisation.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Said "the right to speak freely is the birthright of all Americans" and that burning Pride or BLM flags should be legal.

state-harmful.rationale: He wanted limited government under the Constitution ("our North Star"), not abolition of the state.

limit-guns.rationale: Opposed gun control; said in April 2023 it is worth accepting "some gun deaths every single year" to keep the Second Amendment.

traditional-family.rationale: Repeatedly urged young people to marry and have children, saying children matter more than a career; TPUSA lists family among its traditional values.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Stated in 2019 "I believe marriage is one man, one woman"; on Maher he said same-sex relations are not holy, while saying he wants the Constitution as a guide rather than force.

abortion-legal.rationale: Argued in a 2024 debate that abortion is murder and should be illegal; opposed rape exceptions.

more-religion-public.rationale: Said "I want to see the body politic become Christian"; launched TPUSA Faith to bring churches into politics and said the 2024 election was a spiritual war.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Campaigned against CRT, DEI, affirmative action and disparate impact, saying race should matter less in society.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Said "there are only two genders" (2021) and called being transgender a mental disorder.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Said there is "nothing racist or xenophobic about loving the country so much" and framed his politics as defending Western civilization.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Said at a 2023 campus event that immigration should essentially stop and, in 2025, called for dramatically reducing even legal immigration and ending H-1B visas for Indian workers.

free-trade.rationale: Questioned whether trade is necessary, said trade with China had not made it more Western, and argued tariffs bring production home.

nation-first.rationale: Argued the US should be self-sufficient rather than dependent on China and called for an "America-first" approach, including in education.

open-borders.rationale: Called himself a "non-negotiating hawk" on illegal immigration and said deportation should apply in all cases: "a nation of law, not feelings."

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Called climate-change alarm "complete gibberish nonsense" in 2022, opposed the Paris Agreement and called a green transition "a tyrant's fantasy".

central-planning.rationale: His organisation promotes free markets and limited government, and he credited Milton Friedman as an early influence; no stated support for planned economies.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Backed Trump's tariffs on his show in April 2025 ("like taking cough syrup") and said tariffs make foreign firms relocate production to the US.

separate-church-state.rationale: Held in 2018 that church and state are separate, but said in 2022 "there is no separation of church and state" and called it a fabrication; this later view is used.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Wanted disparate-impact doctrine eliminated and argued race should matter less in society, rejecting outcome-based remedies.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Described himself as "very pro-Israel" and said he believed in "scriptural land rights" for Israel.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Supported Trump's oil-drilling plans, argued phasing out fossil fuels would not help, and told a guest fossil fuels have made life better.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Criticised the share of households speaking another language at home as a failure to learn English, contrasting earlier immigrants.

elite-replacement.rationale: Said in 2024 the "great replacement" strategy aims "to replace white rural America with something different" and posted that it "is not a theory, it's a reality".

party-controls-media.rationale: Objected to being flagged "do not amplify" on Twitter and cited it as censorship; said speech is a birthright.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Advocated Christian creationism and said Darwin had been debunked; no specific school-curriculum proposal found.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Doubted that humans drive rising temperatures and questioned climate science and consensus.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Framed his politics around defending Western civilization against campus ideologies.

patriotic-education.rationale: TPUSA launched an online academy for "America-first education" as an alternative to schools teaching anti-American ideas.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Celebrated the Supreme Court ending race-conscious admissions and listed affirmative action among things to eliminate.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Named disparate impact one of "four horsemen of the anti-racism monster" he wanted eliminated.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Criticised young progressives for pursuing "careerism and consumerism" over family.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Argued that marriage is central to a healthy society and urged young people to marry.

religion-illusion.rationale: An evangelical Christian who said his morals come from the Bible and who co-founded TPUSA Faith.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Cited scriptural land rights as grounds for Israel's claim.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Inferred: he repeatedly compared abortion to the Holocaust, treating it as a real atrocity; no statement on denial itself was found.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Called same-sex relations unholy as a Christian but on Maher separated this from legal rights and said coercion "is not love"; no call to criminalise found.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Called being transgender a mental disorder and called for a nationwide ban on gender-affirming care.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Wanted Christian values in public life and criticised church-state separation as a fabrication by secular humanists.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Said there are only two genders and treated transgender identity as a disorder.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Called the 2024 election "a spiritual war first and foremost" and said he worships a God that defeats evil.

dense-cities.rationale: Opposed a move toward walkable cities, saying without a car "you are a captive of the government in an open air prison".

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Argued the Second Amendment exists so an armed citizenry can check a tyrannical government, not mainly for hunting or self-defense.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Said "When you have multiple gods, you get different moralities" and "I don't seek to be inclusive, I seek what is best."

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Warned climate policy would amount to property confiscation and loss of sovereignty.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Said 22% of households speaking another language at home reflects a failure to learn English.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Said his morals come from the Bible and cited Leviticus; literal-inerrancy not stated explicitly.

close-ties-china.rationale: Said "I don't want to make China richer" and that trade had made China more authoritarian.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Said race should matter less in society and that anti-white racism has grown; no direct statement on the stated claim.

notes: Kirk was killed on 10 September 2025. He moved from a 2018 view that church and state should be separate to saying in 2022 there is no separation; the later view is used. Some quotes (Civil Rights Act, Martin Luther King Jr.) rest on press reports rather than full recordings, so they were not used for answers. Many statements are null because no direct evidence was opened; wording of s12, s13 and s14 comes from secondary reports of his remarks.
